term: I (the letter, sounded as in pique)
headwords: I (the letter, sounded as in pique)

english: I (the letter, sounded as in pique)

header_sentences: See E (the letter, sounded like the a in Fate).

contexts.text: When the spiritual Angels speak... and use U (oo) there is something of I or Y in it.
Instead of I (in the Inmost Heaven) there is nearly Y.
All the vowels (there) = that which conjoins... I there = that which is from what is interior.
The vowels there are for sound, which corresponds to affection; and (the Angels of the Third Heaven) cannot utter the vowels I and E... because... I and E give a close sound.
